narr: Thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. Isolated wind damage occurred in Tucson and Mescal with flash flooding in Oracle and along the Canada Del Oro Wash.
ev: Heavy rain of 2 in 1 hour fell upstream to north of the Catalina Mountains in Pinal County. The Canada Del Oro Wash flowed over its banks south of Edwin Rd.
Heavy rain of 2 in 1 hour in Oracle caused extensive street flooding throughout the town.
